claims.evidence: Brand text visible on frame but not legible; no readable logo or model plate shown
No stress test, material spec, or frame close-up to assess durability
Tire tread/pressure and brake lever/caliper function not shown or demonstrated
Derailleur, chain, and gear shifting not shown or demonstrated in any clip

risks.risk: Frame cracks, rust, or dents on unseen sides
risks.proof: Full 360° photos of frame including underside and joints
Video clip of brake lever squeeze showing wheel stopping

risks.risk: Gear system (derailleur/shifter) not functioning or missing speeds
risks.proof: Video of gear shifting through all speeds while pedaling

risks.risk: Tire condition - cracks, bald tread, or flat spots
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both tires including tread and sidewalls

risks.risk: Folding mechanism (if truly a folding bike) may be loose, rusted, or broken
risks.proof: Video of the bike being folded and unfolded

risks.risk: Frame size unsuitable for buyer's height
risks.proof: Photo with tape measure against frame or full side-view with rider
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown/average size, buyer risk

risks.risk: Unknown age and usage history, hidden wear
risks.proof: Photos of serial number, purchase receipt, or seller's usage history
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily used, worst-case wear

proof_requests: Clear photo of brand/model text or serial number on frame
Video of brakes being tested (squeeze lever, wheel stops)
Video of gears shifting through full range
Close-up photos of both tires (tread and sidewall)
Video of folding/unfolding mechanism in action
Full side-view and 360° photos of frame for rust/damage/size reference
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a bicycle, so it can be priced at worst case given unverified claims about brand, tires, brakes, and gears, with price to rise only upon specific proof.
